name: Pays Basque
author: pierreggt
description: Cross-border map of the French and Spanish Basque Country, from Bayonne/Biarritz/Anglet/Hendaye to Donostia-San Sebastián/Irun/Hondarribia. Two airports (Biarritz, San Sebastián), rail stations on both sides, university campuses (UPPA, UPV/EHU), major hospitals. French side built from INSEE Filosofi/MOBPRO 2021; Spanish side from real INE/Eustat 2024 population with OSM-based job/commute estimation; real cross-border commuter totals from the Eurorégion Nouvelle-Aquitaine-Euskadi-Navarre employment diagnostic.
